scope: Six models × five core endpoints, two scale-E2E controls, four E2E seed1 endpoints; six local QTIP references. This does not certify every auxiliary campaign job.

definitions.macro6_mixed: Equal task mean: acc_norm for ARC-C, ARC-E, HellaSwag, PIQA; acc for LAMBADA and WinoGrande.
definitions.macro6_plain_acc: Equal task mean of all six acc,none values.
definitions.macro5_plain_acc_no_lambada: Equal task mean of five acc,none values excluding LAMBADA.
definitions.delta: candidate minus reference; negative PPL and positive accuracy percentage points are improvements.
definitions.paired_ci: Existing paired stratified bootstrap: sample pairs within each task; equally average six task differences; 20,000 draws, seed 19; 95% percentile interval. Conditional on fixed trained checkpoints, no multiplicity correction.

caveats: Qwen QTIP uses repository adaptation of the official layerwise core without full-model E2E; these are not official paper Qwen results.
Llama QTIP uses official released checkpoints evaluated locally; task/PPL2048 comparisons do not establish official-paper numerical reproduction or identical training/evaluation software.
Vector logical effective bpp includes its recorded metadata, whereas QTIP references supply nominal 2 bpp. The table is not a comparison at exactly equal packed byte size.
Qwen and Llama2 use existing row-scale checkpoints, while Llama3.1 uses group-scale geometry; row results do not alone validate group-specific V19 claims.
Seed1 changes E2E seed only, not calibration subset or V19 training; n=2 cannot establish general seed robustness.
QTIP point comparisons have no paired CI in this aggregation; PPL differences have no confidence interval.
Selection uses held-out calibration validation, not benchmark metrics. V19 selector chooses within the V19 family even if baseline is the overall validation winner.
32B combines original baseline evaluation, recovery training/selection, and eval_recovery evaluations. Separate source snapshots and paths are preserved.
